opennyai_summary.decision:
2. This application is filed by the original complainant under Section 378(4) of the Criminal Procedure Code('Cr.PC') to challenge the order acquitting the respondents for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 307 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4. Leave granted.
5. Appeal is admitted.
For compliance under Section 390 of the Criminal Procedure Code, the trial court shall issue notice to respondent nos. 1 to 4, calling upon them to appear before the trial court on a particular date.
8. Accordingly, respondent no. 1 to 4(accused) shall appear before the trial court on the given date and the trial court shall enlarge him on bail on the same day on appropriate terms and conditions.
One of the conditions shall be for securing the presence of the accused before this court as and when called.
9. In case the respondent no. 1 to 4 (accused) fails to remain present before the trial court as directed by this order, the trial court shall submit a report to this court.
